title: Size bound for recursive circuit combination
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $b$ specify an AND or OR gate, and let $cs$ be a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables. For every natural number $k$, the circuit obtained by recursively combining $cs$ with fuel $k$ has size at most the sum of the sizes of the circuits in $cs$, plus $|cs|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a finite list of circuits on $n$ variables
